purpose: Feed every validation issue back to the planner at once, so a bounded corrective budget is spent on correction rather than on discovering one problem per attempt.

issue_count.description: How many issues the validator reported.

issues.description: The issues rendered by Python, one per line, each naming the step and the field (PlanIssue.message).

expectations: A single JSON object with a `steps` array, re-validated exactly as the first draft was.

metadata.change_reason: First version. Every issue at once, by design: plan.py's module docstring explains why a validator that reports one problem per attempt spends a two-attempt budget on bookkeeping.
